ops.body: Resolved 2026-07-14 with NO manual drain needed. After upgrading to v0.54.0 (formula + cask), restarting the daemon (`brew services restart cc-pool` — note `ccp service install` did NOT actually replace the running v0.53.0 daemon), and the cask relaunching CCPoolStatus.app, ALL 12 domains disappeared from Finder Locations, though only acct-08 was ever explicitly repaired. Mechanism: the daemon's reconcile re-registered every domain through the new app's register() (isHidden=true), and NSFileProviderManager.add on an existing domain propagates property changes — the "idempotent add won't re-apply isHidden" assumption was wrong. Verified: all 12 domains still registered per fileproviderctl dump, reads OK on busy accounts (acct-01/11/14), ccp doctor FP rows clean, zero of the ~47 live sessions disturbed. User visually confirmed the sidebar is empty.
